name: kantorai-foundation
description: KantorAI virtual office and multi-agent platform foundation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @kantorai/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @kantorai/api" "npm run dev -w @kantorai/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kantorai/api && npm run build -w @kantorai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kantorai/api && npm run typecheck -w @kantorai/web
